messages.text: wait. hold up. 🛑 did diego just say we are cutting the mobile app??
i literally have a react native project half done. i spent 3 hours on the splash screen today! 😭
yeah. d5. no native app. no calendar integration. web only.
but... why? we have 25 days. i can make the RN thing work by saturday night easily
diego's privacy concerns on device storage + the fact that debugging RN on our infra is a nightmare. also we need time for the atlas canvas.
ok but my layout work in RN was actually pretty good. the animations!
i know. that's why i said the responsive web layout will carry it. we just reuse the CSS logic, no native bridge.
fine. ugh. i'm mad but i get it. better to have a stable web demo than a flaky app that crashes on the ipad during judging.
exactly. stability > flash. you want to keep the RN code in a branch so we don't lose it?
yes! please. i'll push it to feat/rn-prototype right now before i delete my local state. 😤
done. it's in the repo. don't merge it lol.
you are a menace. ok, back to the login autofill issue then. why is my phone still not suggesting the password?
probably because we're not using standard form semantics yet. i'm adding the autocomplete attributes now.
great. push when ready, i'll test on my pixel and my iphone. 📱
